bio: Most people only sell a home a few times in their lives. It is one of the biggest financial decisions they will ever make and Kirby Chan has built his career around helping it go right.

Kirby is a Broker and the co-founder of Kirby Chan & Co. Real Estate Team, working across Markham, Richmond Hill and the Greater Toronto Area. The team started with a simple commitment to honest, client-first real estate.

His approach is straightforward. He does not push. He listens, he advises and he helps you make the decision that is right for you, not the one that is convenient for him. That is why referrals and returning clients are the foundation of the business.

Kirby runs the team with co-founder Carrie Szeto and a group of dedicated specialists. Together they bring local market knowledge, modern digital marketing and a real understanding of what Markham and Richmond Hill homeowners need when it is time to move.
about.quote: He does not push. He listens, he advises and he helps you make the decision that is right for you.

services.lede: Every move is different. These are the situations we help with most often, with a plain description of how we handle each one.

buying.name: Buying a Home
buying.summary: A clear search, careful checks and offers based on real comparable sales.
buying.body: We help you set a realistic budget, narrow the neighbourhoods that fit your life and check each property carefully before you make an offer.

selling.name: Selling a Home
selling.summary: A price we can defend, proper preparation and marketing that reaches buyers.
selling.body: We price your home on real comparable sales, tell you which preparation is worth the money and market the property to the buyers most likely to pay for it.

luxury.name: Luxury Homes
luxury.summary: Thin comparables, a small buyer pool and no room for a pricing mistake.
luxury.body: Luxury homes in Markham have few direct comparables. We price with care, present the home properly and protect your privacy through the process.

relocation.name: Relocation
relocation.summary: Choosing a neighbourhood you have never lived in, usually on a deadline.
relocation.body: Moving to Markham from another city or country? We explain the neighbourhoods, schools and commute honestly so you can choose with confidence, often from a distance.

downsizing.name: Downsizing
downsizing.summary: Decades in one house and a move that has to happen in the right order.
downsizing.body: We plan the sale and the next home together at a pace that suits you. We also help with the practical side of leaving a long-time family home.

upsizing.name: Upsizing
upsizing.summary: Two transactions, one timeline and a gap that has to be financed.
upsizing.body: Selling one home and buying a larger one means two deals that have to line up. We plan the order, the timing and the financing questions before you commit.

first-time-buyers.name: First-Time Buyers
first-time-buyers.summary: A real budget, a realistic neighbourhood list and no surprises at closing.
first-time-buyers.body: We walk you through every step, from mortgage pre-approval to closing costs, so you always know what comes next and what it will cost.

new-construction.name: New Construction
new-construction.summary: A builder contract written by the builder and a closing that is years away.
new-construction.body: Pre-construction and new homes come with contracts that favour the builder. We review the details with you and explain the risks before you sign.

investors.name: Investors
investors.summary: Numbers that have to work before the story does.
investors.body: We look at rent, carrying costs and resale before the pitch, so an investment property in Markham makes sense on paper first.

estate-sales.name: Estate Sales
estate-sales.summary: A sale run by an executor, usually during a very hard year.
estate-sales.body: We help executors and families sell an estate property with patience and clear communication, working alongside the estate lawyer at every step.

separation-and-divorce.name: Separation and Divorce
separation-and-divorce.summary: A shared home, two people moving on and a sale that has to be fair to both.
separation-and-divorce.body: We keep both parties equally informed, work alongside each person's lawyer and run a sale that is transparent from pricing to closing.

neighbourhoods.lede: Each Markham neighbourhood has its own character, housing, schools and transit. Here is a short introduction to each one.

unionville.tagline: Heritage main street, mature trees and the best-known name in the city.
unionville.body: A nineteenth century main street with a GO station at the end of it. Unionville is the neighbourhood most people picture when they think of Markham and prices carry a premium to match.

markham-village.tagline: The original town centre, with older homes and deep lots.
markham-village.body: The original Markham. A working main street, deep lots and houses from more than a century of building, all within a short walk of a GO station.

cornell.tagline: Front porches, rear lane garages and a hospital nearby.
cornell.body: A planned community in east Markham built on a street grid, with front porches, garages on rear lanes and Markham Stouffville Hospital at its edge.

berczy-village.tagline: Family first, school focused and priced accordingly.
berczy-village.body: North Markham family territory. Newer detached homes and townhomes, quiet crescents and a school reputation that attracts many buyers.

cathedraltown.tagline: Built around a cathedral, with a distinctive streetscape.
cathedraltown.body: A planned community built around a cathedral, with stricter architectural control than anywhere else in Markham and a look that people either love or do not.

wismer.tagline: Newer family housing with a GO station nearby.
wismer.body: Wismer Commons is the quiet middle of north Markham. Newer family homes, strong demand for its schools and a GO station close enough to use.

greensborough.tagline: The northeast corner, built around a GO station.
greensborough.body: Northeast Markham built around Mount Joy GO. Newer housing, plenty of townhomes and a short walk to the train for many streets.

angus-glen.tagline: Executive homes, a championship golf course and large lots.
angus-glen.body: Markham's executive address north of Major Mackenzie Drive, with large lots, a championship golf club and a well-known community centre.

box-grove.tagline: A historic hamlet with newer housing built around it.
box-grove.body: A nineteenth century hamlet surrounded by newer subdivisions, tucked into the southeast corner of Markham beside Highway 407.

thornhill.tagline: Mature, established and split from Vaughan by Yonge Street.
thornhill.body: Thornhill is divided between Markham and Vaughan along Yonge Street. The Markham side has some of the most established housing in the city.

milliken-mills.tagline: On the Toronto border, with the lowest entry point for a house.
milliken-mills.body: Markham's south end along Steeles Avenue. Older housing, strong transit connections and often the most accessible price for a detached home in the city.

downtown.tagline: The most walkable part of Markham.
downtown.body: Downtown Markham was designed to be urban, with condo towers, restaurants, a cinema and the York University Markham Campus close together.
